name: 牛津布书包位儿童雨衣款
description: 牛津布防雨、透明大帽檐、书包位与反光条，雨天安心外穿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, sky blue #45C5E8 for detail panels, sunny orange #FF8A3D for hero and CTA accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with front-left key and soft fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars on coated fabric
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light board #EFEAE2 and soft rainy outdoor ambience for scene shots
styleLock.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif, friendly and legible
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line weather icons in one accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, garment always fully spread or naturally worn
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cheerful kids rainwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sky blue #45C5E8, sunny orange #FF8A3D and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line weather icons; clean playful product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：1 屏四色系海报主图（防雨/透气/环保角标）；2 屏饼图占比与检测报告（96%复购、通过面料检测，属不可验证数据）；3 屏有/无书包位双款；4 屏四色命名与尺码量法线稿；5 屏尺码表（身高段 90-145cm 的 M-XXL）；6 屏面料泼水珠微距与透明帽檐；7 屏帽檐与抽绳细节、防水拉链；8 屏防水袖口与翻盖口袋；9 屏内里加宽防水压胶与手提袋（袋上原有品牌字样）；10 屏黄色小鹿帽形侧脸展示；11-15 屏四色童模室内场景展示（蓝考拉/绿小狗/黄小鹿/粉绵羊，多为背影与背后反光条）。品类判定：尺码表按身高段分 M-XXL、成衣为连帽雨披外穿形态、文案诉求为雨天出行防雨，属外穿童装而非贴身内衣，故判为 母婴/童装/儿童牛津布连帽雨衣，与源夹名一致。收敛：15 屏合并四色重复角色（4/11-15 屏并为一镜四色阵列与一镜书包位双款），丢弃 2 屏占比图与报告屏（数据不可验证、涉及原机构报告），11-15 屏同质场景合并为雨夜背影一镜，共 12 镜。已剥离：原品牌字样与手提袋印字、检测报告与机构名、复购占比数据、童模面容（全部改为背影或颈部以下）、尺码表实测数值（改为空白标注位）、卡通印花的具体图文（仅保留帽形与图位结构，图案交由 product_identity_lock）。
